title: AirPrompter signed release manifest
description: What a target is allowed to run, as a signed envelope. The platform signature covers the whole payload; countersignatures cover the releaseDigest of every release the manifest can activate (D58). No prompt text is ever in a manifest: slots name payloads by content hash and the runtime fetches them separately.

signatures.description: Platform signatures over the canonical JSON of `payload` (see canonical-json.md). At least `threshold` of them (from the key-set's `targets` role) must verify.

countersignatures.description: Customer countersignatures (§6.3). Each signs one releaseDigest with a customer-held key. Present but empty when the target does not require countersign; on a countersign target every arm's releaseDigest must have one or the manifest is refused.

identifier.description: A canonical team identifier as minted by the control plane.

keyId.description: The RFC 7638 JWK thumbprint of the public key, lowercase hex (trust-chain.md). Root metadata listing a key under any other id is refused.

modelId.description: Provider model identifier, exactly as the target's reported catalog names it.

outputCheck.description: One declared output check (checks.md, 5-E): deterministic, evaluated on the host on the output the SDK already sees, counted on the window as `checks.passed` / `checks.failed`. The projection a pin carries: enabled checks only, the kind's own members, sorted by `name` — part of the release digest input when the list is non-empty.

schema.description: json_schema: the JSON Schema subset checks.md names; at most 16 KiB.

path.description: enum: a dotted path into the parsed JSON output (`category`, `items.0.kind`); empty for the whole trimmed output.

minTokens.description: length: output tokens, from the provider's usage when reported, else ceil(UTF-8 bytes / 4).

pattern.description: must_match / must_not_match: RE2-class syntax only (no backreferences, lookaround, atomic or possessive groups, or nested quantifiers), at most 256 characters; an output over 64 KiB fails the check closed.

trust.description: D55: `end_user` values are rendered only inside the delimiters the author declared and never in an instruction-role position without an explicit acknowledgement at seal time.

goldenSetRef.description: T34: what a slot carries for its golden set (golden-sets.md) — the cases themselves are the payload under `contentHash`, encrypted at rest like a prompt.

minPassBps.description: Pass-rate floor in basis points; a run below it leaves the release staged.

slot.description: One pinned slot. These members, sorted by `tag`, are exactly the release digest input (canonical-json.md); `modelRequired` is part of it only when true, `outputChecks` and `goldenSet` only when present.

modelRequired.description: The model is required: a runtime whose declared catalog lacks it refuses to activate the release (heartbeat refusal `model_unavailable`) instead of rendering the slot on another model. Omitted when false; in the digest input only when true.

outputChecks.description: The slot's enabled output checks, sorted by name (checks.md). Omitted when none; in the digest input only when present.

goldenSet.description: T34: the slot's golden set — 1–50 known inputs with the properties a right answer has, run by the runtime against the pinned model before a staged release activates (golden-sets.md). Omitted when none; in the digest input only when present.

steps.description: Workflow slots only: ordered steps, 1-based and contiguous, tagged `<tag>#<ordinal>`.

releaseDigest.description: The release this arm activates. The control arm carries the manifest's own releaseDigest; on a countersign target every arm's digest must be countersigned.

overrides.description: Slots that differ from the top-level `slots` under this arm, by tag. The control arm has none.

experiment.description: A/B split or staged rollout (§8). Arms are evaluated in order against the sticky assignment bucket (assignment-hash.md); weights sum to exactly 10000.

tag.description: S16: the one slot this experiment splits. Required on every entry of experiments[]; absent on the legacy top-level experiment, which applies to every slot its arms override. An arm's overrides under a tagged experiment name that tag only.

salt.description: Random per-experiment salt, base64url without padding; the decoded bytes prefix the subject in the hash.

ramp.description: S9: the signed ramp plan. The runtime walks it on its own clock: the weights in force are the last step whose notBefore has passed (inclusive), else arms[].weightBps. Steps are strictly increasing, at least an hour apart, one weight per arm each summing to 10000 (assignment-hash.md › The ramp plan; refused as ramp_invalid). A customer on unlock_required unlocks the plan once; the cloud can only retreat (disable scope arm).

directive.description: Signed, advisory instructions from the control plane. The set of kinds is closed (S4): `disable` is the one kind a runtime acts on without a local act — a reduction, it only ever stops serving (scope agent / slot) or hands an arm's share back to the control (scope arm, S9: the retreat from a ramp); `request_unlock` is a request the runtime surfaces and never grants. A runtime that meets a kind it does not know refuses the whole manifest (`directive_unknown`), never obeys it by halves. A runtime may always be stricter than a directive asks; on countersign targets only `disable` is honoured from the manifest (D58).

experimentId.description: S16: with scope arm, the experiment the arm belongs to — required once a manifest carries experiments[] (arm names are per experiment); a legacy manifest may omit it.

generation.description: Strictly monotonic per target, including on server-side rollback. A runtime refuses a manifest whose generation is lower than the one it stores.

releaseDigest.description: sha256 over the canonical JSON of the digest input built from `slots` (canonical-json.md). Together with `target` it identifies the release.

leaseSeconds.description: Staleness accounting, not a kill switch (§6.4). Advisory on countersign targets.

onLeaseExpiry.description: `degrade` keeps serving the last verified release and reports it; `halt` stops rendering. Advisory on countersign targets, where local configuration decides.

unlockWindow.description: The console's update window (D33): a release staged under unlock_required activates on its own inside it. Advisory — a runtime's local apply.window wins, and the local side is never looser. Present only with unlock_required.

start.description: Local wall-clock HH:MM, 24-hour; a window whose end precedes its start runs past midnight and belongs to the day it starts on.

days.description: Days the window opens on, in the zone; absent = every day.

slots.description: Every live slot of the release. Sorted by tag; tags are unique.

experiment.description: The legacy single split (protocol 0.2): applies to every slot its arms override. Written only while a fleet has not reported protocol 0.3; never beside experiments[] (refused as experiment_conflict).

experiments.description: S16: one split per slot, each independent — its own salt, arms, ramp and share (assignment-hash.md › Per-prompt experiments). Tags are unique across the array; each arm's overrides name that experiment's tag only. Never beside experiment (experiment_conflict).

sig.description: ECDSA P-256 over SHA-256 of the canonical payload bytes, IEEE P1363 (r ‖ s, 64 bytes), base64url without padding.
ECDSA P-256 over SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of `releaseDigest` (the `sha256:…` string), P1363, base64url without padding.
